Airport Splits Its Parking Into Three Areas
The single lot at Linden Regional Airport has become three areas with separate rules and rates.
By Nolan Sedgwick, Transportation Reporter
Since June, drivers at Linden Regional Airport have parked in one of three areas instead of the single lot that served the terminal for years. Over the first two months, staff counted about a third more vehicles left overnight than in the same period last year, and most of that increase was recorded in Elmgate.
The three areas differ in how they charge. Drivers who leave a car for only a few hours can pay by the hour in Elmgate, while those who stay longer are charged by the day or, in Tilbury, by the week.
"Offering drivers a choice of distance and price has filled spaces that used to sit empty," said Yvonne Salcedo, who manages airport operations. "I accept that many regular travelers who once walked to the terminal from their cars now ride the shuttle instead, and not all of them are pleased."
A further change takes effect on October 1, when Cransley will begin holding its spaces for drivers with reservations and will no longer allow any stay to run beyond four days. Drivers who plan longer stays, or who arrive without a booking, will need to use one of the other two areas.
A full comparison of the three areas appears below.
----------------------
Passenger Parking: Comparison of Areas
Rules in force since June 1
Covers the three passenger areas only. Staff and rental vehicles use a separate area that is closed to passengers.
Cransley	Elmgate	Tilbury
Access to terminal	On foot	Free shuttle bus	Free shuttle bus
Time to terminal	6 minutes	12 minutes	18 minutes
Maximum stay	30 days until October 1, then 4 days	30 days	60 days
Charges	Per day	Per hour for the first 3 hours, then per day	Per week (b)
Advance booking	Required from October 1 (a)	Not required	Not required
Vehicle height limit	None	2.1 meters	None
(a) Cransley reservations close at 6:00 P.M. on the day before arrival.
(b) In Tilbury, each period of seven days is charged as one week, and a partial week is charged as a full week.
Reserve online at lindenairport.com/parking.

By Douglas Pascoe, Business Reporter
Until now, clients of Mowbray Office Catering could ask for delivery on any weekday, so orders from one street often traveled on three vans. "The food was never the problem," said operations director Hannah Villanueva. "We were sending drivers through the same districts twice before noon."
To address this, from April 6 each service area will have a regular route with a single delivery day, prepared at one of the company's two kitchens. Under the new schedule, the Ellerby Street kitchen will start an hour early on Thursdays, since that day's route will carry more meals than any other.

L4	All areas, on request	Hadleigh	Wednesday	Noon, three working days ahead	25 meals

Lunch Deliveries Move to Fixed Routes
By Douglas Pascoe, Business Reporter
Until now, clients of Mowbray Office Catering could ask for delivery on any weekday, so orders from one street often traveled on three vans. "The food was never the problem," said operations director Hannah Villanueva. "We were sending drivers through the same districts twice before noon."
To address this, from April 6 each service area will have a regular route with a single delivery day, prepared at one of the company's two kitchens. Under the new schedule, the Ellerby Street kitchen will start an hour early on Thursdays, since that day's route will carry more meals than any other.
Route details appear in the delivery schedule.
----------------------
Mowbray Office Catering — Lunch Delivery Routes
In effect from April 6
Route	Service areas	Kitchen	Delivery day	Order cutoff	Minimum order
L1	Duxford, Sowerby	Ellerby	Tuesday	3 P.M., two working days ahead	12 meals
L2	Grenford	Ellerby	Thursday	3 P.M., two working days ahead	12 meals
L3	Tenbury, Eddington	Hadleigh	Friday	Noon, three working days ahead	15 meals
L4	All areas, on request	Hadleigh	Wednesday	Noon, three working days ahead	25 meals
Route L3 orders cannot be increased after the cutoff.
Queries about routes L1 and L2 go to Owen Duarte. Queries about routes L3 and L4 go to Lucia Chowdhury.
----------------------
To: Miriam Vogel, Ockford Design Partners
Subject: Change to your lunch deliveries
Account: LD-6193
From: Karl Jessup
Date: March 18
Dear Ms. Vogel,
From April 6, our lunch deliveries will run on fixed routes. Your office has taken our Wednesday delivery for six years. However, your area, Duxford, has now been assigned to route L1, which delivers on Tuesdays.
You may either accept Tuesday delivery or keep your Wednesday delivery by ordering through route L4. Each route's cutoff and minimum order appear in the published schedule.
Please reply by April 1 naming the arrangement you prefer. The coordinator responsible for Duxford's assigned route will then call you to confirm your choice.
Karl Jessup
Order Desk Manager
Order desk hours: Tuesday through Friday, 8 A.M. to 4 P.M. Replies reach the shared desk, not the sender.

Claudia Webb — Posted April 2
Unit rented: No. 12
Time as a renter: 14 months
Score: 4 out of 5
I keep stock for a small online business at this site, and I chose it for the long opening hours. Over my time here the place has been clean and reliable, and I stop by a few times each week. This is my third storage company, and by far the easiest to deal with. My one trouble is loading. Carrying boxes to and from my unit is hard work, and I wish I could bring my van closer. I had understood that renters must stay in the block they first sign up for. Is there anything that would make loading easier for me?
Would recommend to others: Yes.

Site Team — Posted April 3
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us. One point needs putting right: renters are not tied to their first block, so a move is certainly possible. For the loading you describe, Block B would suit you much better. Any move must meet two conditions: a free unit in that block, and notice before the end of the month. To get started, please follow the steps given at the end of the block chart.
The Site Team

Office Machine Repairs at Halverton
By Trevor Nilsen, Services Correspondent
Halverton Equipment Care, which services office beverage machines across the district, now handles reported faults in one of two ways. A technician visits the client's own office, or the machine is collected and repaired at the company's service center. Either option is offered within one week.
Rachel Tomlin, the firm's service manager, said the second option was added last year because requests for same-week visits were rising faster than technicians could keep up with. "Now every client can be given a fixed date for the work," she said.
Both options are available under the standard care agreement, which includes servicing of up to six machines at each client address. Replaceable supplies such as water filters are billed separately.
Full terms appear in the company's printed price list.
----------------------
To: Service Department, Halverton Equipment Care
From: Teresa Kilbride, Marnfield Insurance Services
Date: September 22
Subject: Kitchen machine fault
Reference: Care agreement MC-2740
Dear Service Department,
Your team handled our last fault promptly, and we were pleased. Now the machine in our ground-floor kitchen has stopped heating water, and we would like to arrange a repair.
Our first choice is a technician visit here within the next three days. If no technician is free this week, please collect the machine and repair it at your service center. Your terms state that a machine is lent to us at no charge while ours is away. Could you confirm today which arrangement you will make?
For your records, we also installed two more machines in the upstairs kitchen last month, so eight are now in use at this address.
Sincerely,
Teresa Kilbride
Office Manager
Direct extension 176
----------------------
Halverton Equipment Care
Bill to: Marnfield Insurance Services
Document number: 7156
Issue date: September 30
Agreement reference: MC-2740
Service date: September 24
Off-site servicing, one unit — included under agreement — $0.00
Replacement water filter*, one unit — $34.00

Payment is due within 14 days. Please include the document number above with your payment so that it can be matched to your account. Questions about charges should go to the service department, not to this billing office.
